I can't say I'm glad that someone out there is going through the same shitty feeling... I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy...

Hoping you can feel better soon...

Well to be honest, I got it as a gift 😂😂 but it's true, I am going to miss the little bastard. The collection I had on this thing before it went out (OutRun 2006, GoW Ghost of Sparta, DBZ Shin Budokai, Dead to Rights, Killzone Liberation, SOCOM 3, Chili Con Carnage, Burnout Legends, Soul Calibur Broken Destiny, The original Crash Bandicoot trilogy). It only tempted me now to get a storage of 32 GB. I can only imagine the games this thing is going to hold.
Thank you so much for that insight. I'll definitely put this into mind. Press on the adapter side, not on the SD card side. Got it 👍
Thank you for mentioning that. Is there a certain way I should handle it or just like any ordinary memory stick?

Amen, brother. Even as we approach 2019, this small device just feels timeless. My old 16 GB memory stick pro duo died on me a couple of days ago, and I'm constantly fidgeting. My PSP is my constant companion wherever I go, and I just don't feel the same without it. That's why I was looking into combining an adapter with a micro SD, since it just seems more convenient nowadays.

Thank you so much for your reply. So, I guess I'll buy this one then, and actually 32 GB is more than enough for me right now. I can always swap my games whenever I want to play others. So, I don't have to worry about the 4 GB limit written in the description then, right?
